title: psacalium cirsiifolium
intro: Psacalium cirsiifolium, commonly known as Coyote Mint, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Psacalium cirsiifolium include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
